question_group: Questions 5 to 7 are based on the news report you have just heard.

options.A: One of his friends was caught littering.
options.B: Other tourists refused to join in the cleanup.
options.C: The beautiful beach was spoiled with lots of trash.
options.D: The kilometer-long beach was practically deserted.

options.A: The tourists' good deed was not noticed by the locals.
